4499-5070-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1724-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sekki.
When Sekki dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

206-3259-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
206-3259-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Samut, Tyrant Smasher can be omitted.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1308-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating six 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Ojer Taq and Anointed Procession.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1270-1308-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 7^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 42 after the first iteration, 294 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

215-3443-7296.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-7296.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-7296.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

345-5641-7306.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

2919-5789-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-5789-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-5240-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

1824-2510-2530-5061.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1824-2510-2530-5061.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2510-2530-5061.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1824-2510-2530-5061.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Staff of the Death Magus triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

240-2511-3480-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

396-6972-7136.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Aquastrand Spider.
396-6972-7136.description:
Kill Aquastrand Spider.
When Aquastrand Spider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its graft ability.
When Aquastrand Spider enters, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Aquastrand Spider triggers, moving a +1/+1 counter from it to the creature token. Aquastrand Spider dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

874-1170-1329-3464.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-3464.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Delif's Cone.
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

315-2231-4465--138.description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

851-4050-4533-4807.notablePrerequisites: You control less than three Blood tokens.
851-4050-4533-4807.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Falkenrath Forebear, adding {B}.
When Falkenrath Forebear dies, Voldaren Bloodcaster triggers, creating two Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Falkenrath Forebear by paying {B} and sacrificing the Blood tokens, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1491-2033-4029-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2033-4029-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2033-4029-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2523-3967-5562.notablePrerequisites: Stalwarts of Osgiliath is your Ring-bearer.
2523-3967-5562.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Stalwarts of Osgiliath.
When Stalwarts of Osgiliath dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Stalwarts of Osgiliath that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3951-5147-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-5147-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

372-1018-2417.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1018-2417.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2511-5805--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
2511-5805--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, as well as a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
The +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on that creature are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat.

5330-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
5330-5776-5777.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1409-1633-2039-2397-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Spirit.
You have no cards in hand.
Torrential Gearhulk is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1409-1633-2039-2397-5195.description:
Activate Torrential Gearhulk by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Torrential Gearhulk enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Torrential Gearhulk.
Resolve a Torrential Gearhulk trigger, casting Hanabi Blast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, returning Hanabi Blast to your hand, and then causing you to discard Hanabi Blast.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

771-1378-2493-4886.notablePrerequisites:
Wildfire Eternal does not have summoning sickness.
Mirage Phalanx is paired with Archaeomancer.
An opponent cannot block Wildfire Eternal.
771-1378-2493-4886.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mirage Phalanx and Archaeomancer each trigger, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer and Mirage Phalanx with haste and without soulbond.
When the token Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Savage Beating to your hand from your graveyard.
Declare Wildfire Eternal as an attacker.
When Wildfire Eternal is not blocked, it triggers, casting Savage Beating from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Savage Beating, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, the Mirage Phalanx and Archaeomancer tokens trigger, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.

81-4896.notablePrerequisites: Kami of Whispered Hopes does not have summoning sickness and has a power of at least five.
81-4896.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W} or {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

914-1235-1809.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1235-1809.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist and Returned Pastcaller with haste.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1171-1369-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Quicksilver Elemental.
1171-1369-4222.description:
Activate Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, targeting Garth One-Eye.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat for infinite blue mana.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, targeting Garth One-Eye.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Repeat for infinite colored mana.

352-2320.notablePrerequisites:
You control lands that can produce at least {2}{U}{R}.
An additional
352-2320.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast Reset by paying {U}{U}.
In response, activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Reset.
Allow the Reset copy to resolve, untapping your lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If your lands can produce at least one additional mana, this combo produces infinite mana.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Nivix Guildmage's abilities any number of times.
